adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that in lib/tasks/disqus.thor, the old code `creator = PostCreator.new(user, title: t[:title], raw: "\[[Permalink](#{t[:link]})\]", created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at]), category: category_id)` is replaced with `post = TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`. The new TopicEmbed.import_remote method (shown in app/models/topic_embed.rb) only accepts user, url, and opts (with title), and passes to TopicEmbed.import which calls PostCreator without any created_at parameter. The created_at timestamp from the Disqus thread is indeed lost in the new implementation, while child posts still use their historical dates (p[:created_at] is still used for replies). This is a real data loss bug affecting historical thread chronology.
